There are 95 printable ASCII characters. There are over 65,536 or so printable unicode characters. Unicode allows for much stronger passwords. But I agree it's not absolutely necessary for secure software. I personally think we should leave this in.

But I can be convinced that in a world of MFA it doesn't matter as much.
